title: Monkeys Spinning Monkeys
description: Loopable happy light fluffy piece with bright flutes and a bunch of pizzicato strings.

title: Sneaky Snitch
description: An oboe and a snare drum dance a tantalizing number with the whimsical plucks of a string quartet. The staccato nature of the music suggests walking on tiptoes, while the nasal notes of the oboe flits about almost imperceptibly. In the final minute, the string quartet plays a simple rhythm, before the oboe and snare drum crescendo to the finale.

title: Fluffing a Duck
instruments: Tuba, Flute, Trombones, Bass Clarinet, Clarinet, Percussion
description: A trombone plays a humorous melody alongside timpanis and a variety of woodwind instruments. This music is suited for a short theme for a comedic piece that relies on visual jokes.  2 Small versions in one file.

title: Carefree
description: Nothing says "It'll be okay" quite like a ukulele.

title: Pixelland
description: What do you get when you cross some 8-bit music technology with Dixieland music? Well... you get stuff that sounds like this. The uncompressed download comes with a pile of extra stuff, like versions at 220, 230, 240, and a whopping 275 beats per minute! That's really fast. It also has loops that don't go through the modulation so you can repeat them as long as you'd like!

title: Local Forecast - Elevator
instruments: Piano, Bass, Drum Kit, Electric Piano, Flute, Trumpet, Percussion, Guitar
description: This tempo has a very should-be-in-a-lift vibe. So I processed it and mixed it to sound like crappy elevator speakers. Why not go all the way?  Available in 2 other versions (original, and slower).

title: Scheming Weasel (faster version)
instruments: English Horn, Bassoons, Bass, Glockenspiel, Clarinet, Celesta, Triangle, Bass Clarinet
description: Sort of cartoonish, and yet sort of dark. I couldn't decide the tempo, so I posted a slower and faster version of the piece.

title: Investigations
instruments: Pizzicato Strings, English Horn, Bassoon, Marimba, Glockenspiel, Cowbells
description: Sort of a loafing comedic piece for all of your amusing scenes with dialog that does not need to move the story. Also reasonable for scenes with no dialog.

title: Jaunty Gumption
description: Mid-90s styled happy happy video game music.

title: Happy Boy Theme
description: Happy bouncy theme for a comic hero! Written for Craig Knitt's short "Happy Boy".

title: Hyperfun
description: Some ragtime, some western saloon piano, all fun. More fun than you can handle. That's HYPERfun!

title: Wallpaper
description: Very very clean mix that is non-offensive on almost all fronts. Good spectral distribution - nice lows and highs. 2 catchy synth lines sort of fight for attention, leaving you to ignore them both after a while.

title: Sunshine
description: A bright piece with piano and rhythm guitar throughout.  Kit and Bass in the background.  Main melody carried by Piano.

title: Happy Alley
description: Very upbeat and peppy piece with an usual bridge, all driven by an acoustic guitar.

title: Merry Go
description: Comedic and playful, this rag-time ditty has a strong melody, and is heavy in the bass chords. The second minute features flighty finger-work, as if an energetic bee is flying up and down the scales. The last thirty seconds is a refrain of the introduction, and the piece ends with an invigorating flourish.

title: Life of Riley
description: Mid-tempo cheery music for all!

title: Maccary Bay
description: Modern sort of reggae with a lots of layers! Features the wah-riffic guitar work of Mr. Brett VanDonsel.

title: Fretless
instruments: Guitar, Ukulele, Drums, Bass, Glockenspiel, Music Box
description: Nice, forward-pulling piece pretty much guaranteed to offend no one. This piece is a little more complex than others in this genre because of the multiple countermelodies. They clear out many times, and make room before coming back in. You can make your own mixes with the uncompressed downloads to only include the melodies you want if you like!

title: Cipher
description: I've been told this is R&B, but could be a few other things. It is certainly pretty neat. Warning: Very sticky hook.

title: Itty Bitty 8 Bit
description: Playful and interesting, Itty Bitty 8-Bit immediately introduces you to a pulsating melody flitting above a synthesized bass. The melody changes in the second minute and builds while climbing the chromatic scale, before settling back into the familiar refrain. This could be looped for a classic-styled videogame that is quirky and imaginative.

title: Bit Quest
description: Wonderful 8-Bit ditty for an exploring action adventure platformer. My favorite part is at 16 seconds in... The rest of the piece was written around that theme. Check it out, yo! Careful of the spiked kittens on level 7... not cuddly.

title: Move Forward
description: Mid-90s styled happy happy video game music.

title: Sneaky Adventure
description: Tight pizz string section, joined by a lone bassoon on the recapitulation.

title: The Builder
instruments: Strings, Bass, Cello, Viola, Violin, Brass, Tuba, Trombone, Trumpet, Woodwinds, Bassoon, English Horn, Oboe, Percussion, Marimba
description: Comedic, free-wheeling fun!

title: Amazing Plan
description: With elements of a quick Russian polka playing in the immigrant section of industrial-era New York City, this piece is mainly in a minor key, but at the halfway point changes to a major key, reversing the feel and tone for a few seconds, before reverting to the darkness of the minor key.

title: Marty Gots a Plan
instruments: Cello, Viola, Violin, English Horn, Alto Flute, Percussion, Marimba
description: Sneaking around the house? Use this! Planning a comedic caper? Also good! Semi-random pizzicato is like magic for cheeky hijinks. You know... when Marty gots a plan, it aint usually a good one.

title: Quirky Dog
description: Smooth and jazzy ditty with a fun edge for all your light humor needs! Okay, many of your light humor needs. Excellent for montage sequences dealing with bureaucracy.

title: Comic Hero
description: Tuba carries the character of the piece.

title: The Show Must Be Go
instruments: Bass, Guitar, Diddley Bow, Clarinet, Trumpet, Vibraphone, Horns, Drum Kit, Percussion
description: Sort of inspired by the 1930s, and sort of inspired by all-out weird. Definitely recommend taking a listen to this piece. Make sure you get to the 1 minute mark... fun times trumpet playing await! I personally enjoy how the clarinet play tries to follow the trumpet player - doesn't work out so well.

title: Funkorama
instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Organ, Synth
description: Clean audio mix with an interesting electronic drum kit and odd chord progressions. Nice grooving bass line.

title: On My Way
instruments: Bass, Guitar, Flutes, Clarinets, Vibraphone, Drums
description: If you're not adding to the narrative; get out of the way! This piece gets out of the way... You can put it under any monolog, dialog, timelapse... actually, with a timelapse, you could probably find something a little more interesting with some pacing, or something. So... this is for those sure nice videos. Guaranteed* to offend as few people as possible!  *"Guaranteed" is used in this context for entertainment purposes only.

title: Motivator
description: Classic style corporate-presentation rock piece.

title: Getting it Done
description: Extremely satisfying sound design with super clean bloopy synths in a light dance context. Recommended for all your needs. Unless you need a fire suppression system. It won't work for that. Unless you need music for your fire suppression system. It will work for that.

title: Happy Happy Game Show
description: Okay, it is a 12 bar blues, but you got to stick around at least until the horns! I couldn't start with the horns as that would be a frightening level of happy. The uncompressed download also comes with a perfectly loopable track for those who don't want the party to end.

title: Batty McFaddin
description: Gimme a C; a bouncy C! Fun, quirky, off key off colour piece with a few different feels in the middle.

title: The Cannery
description: A giant rousing mechanized heavy piano and heavy percussion piece, mildly reminiscent of Gershiwn or Scott - in 2 small sections.
